answer_result.answer: Calvin said it started in August of the previous year—August 2022, relative to his 2023-10-19 message—when he met Frank Ocean at a festival and Frank said he wanted to collaborate.

question.question: When did Calvin and Frank Ocean start collaborating?

evidence_items.text:
Dave: Hey Calvin! Haven't talked in a while! Last Friday I had a card-night with my friends, it was so much fun. We laughed and had a great time! Take a look at the photo!
[Image caption: a photography of a group of men sitting at a table with playing cards]
[S15T1] (dia_id: D15:1)

Calvin: Hey Dave! Great to hear from you, card night sounds like a blast! Always love having fun with friends. Guess what? I scored a deal to continue collaboration with Frank Ocean! This is a dream come true for me, I've been working hard and it's finally paying off. No words can describe how happy I am.
[S15T2] (dia_id: D15:2)

Dave: Wow Calvin, congrats! Super excited for you. How did this chance come up?
[S15T3] (dia_id: D15:3)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I had the opportunity to meet Frank Ocean at a music festival in Tokyo and we clicked. We've been speaking and sharing ideas we arranged a meeting and recorded a song in the studio at my mansion - it's been great!
[S15T4] (dia_id: D15:4)

Dave: Wow, Tokyo sounds like an incredible experience!
[S15T5] (dia_id: D15:5)

Calvin: It was an incredible experience, Dave! The city was buzzing with energy and the festival crowd was so lively - it was like fuel for my soul. Look at this photo, that's amazing!
[Image caption: a photo of a crowd of people sitting on the grass at night]
[S15T6] (dia_id: D15:6)

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-08-14, when Dave asked for pictures from the show, shared a photo from the tour's closing show in Tokyo (details in ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20)): a crowd of people at the concert with their hands up — "It was so awesome - I loved how the crowd was into it. These moments are why I love my job." [S14T8].
- On 2023-08-14, said the tour's closing show was "buzzing" — "It's moments like these that make me so proud and motivated" — and that he's "all about spreading joy with my art" [S14T10].
- As of 2023-08-22, scored a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean and recorded a song in the studio at his mansion (details in ## Frank Ocean collaboration) [S15T2][S15T4].
- On 2023-08-22, when Dave asked if any other collaborations came out of the performance, said someone noticed his performance and now they're working together — "which is wild"; the collaborator's identity is not specified (a new collaborator besides Frank Ocean, or Frank Ocean himself — unconfirmed) [S15T10].
- On 2023-08-31 (octopus-guitar chat, see ## Octopus guitar), after Dave said his unique style really stands out in his music and playing, Calvin said he's glad Dave appreciates it: trying to stay true to himself and be unique in his music is something he values [S16T24].
- On 2023-09-13, told Dave his album finally dropped on 2023-09-11 ("the 11th" as of 2023-09-13) — it was "a wild feeling"; everyone's been loving it, and it's motivated him to keep going [S18T1].

Calvin: Hey Dave! Been a few days since we talked, but lots happened. Started touring with Frank Ocean and it's been amazing - so much energy from the crowd, such a connection when I'm on stage - unreal! Take a look at how I performed on stage, that was awesome!
[Image caption: a photo of a band performing on stage with bright lights]
[S24T1] (dia_id: D24:1)

Dave: Congrats, Calvin! That's awesome. Being able to play your music to a crowd and feel that connection must be unreal. How's the tour going?
[S24T2] (dia_id: D24:2)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! The tour has been great, the energy from the crowd is awesome and jamming with Frank Ocean is a dream come true. It's been amazing!
[S24T3] (dia_id: D24:3)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! I bet performing with him is like a dream come true! How did it happen?
[S24T4] (dia_id: D24:4)

Calvin: It all started August last year when we met at a festival and he said he wanted to collaborate. We clicked right away and the chemistry on stage was incredible. I'm so lucky! Check the photo, of how we perfectly look together on stage!
[Image caption: a photo of a band performing on stage with a projection of a man on the wall]
[S24T5] (dia_id: D24:5)

Dave: Wow, Calvin - you and Frank are so in tune! It's clear you both rock on stage. Can't wait to catch your show!
[S24T6] (dia_id: D24:6)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'm so excited you'll be at one of our shows. It's such a great experience, you'll definitely enjoy it! Look at this crowd, that was insane!
[Image caption: a photo of a large crowd of people in a large auditorium]
[S24T7] (dia_id: D24:7)

Dave: That sounds really exciting! Can't wait to experience it. I'm sure everyone in the crowd is going to be pumped up!
[S24T8] (dia_id: D24:8)

- On 2023-10-04, when Dave asked what he works on to relax, Calvin shared a photo of a shiny orange car with its hood open and said he loves working on this project "to chill out" (a car project Calvin is working on himself — distinct from his own Ferrari, see ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26); makes sense given his long-standing finding that working on/fixing cars relaxes him "like meditation," see the 2023-05-31 entry in ## Relationships) [S21T3].
- On 2023-10-15, when Dave (feeling discouraged after his shop lost a deal to a competitor) asked how he stays motivated when faced with setbacks: "When setbacks come my way, I remind myself why I'm passionate about my goals. I rely on helpful people around me and take a break to recharge with my favorite activities. That always helps me get back to feeling motivated." (complements his earlier 2023-07-21 answer about staying motivated, see above) [S23T3][S23T4].
- On 2023-10-15, said performing with Frank Ocean "recently has been really cool" — said while reacting to Dave's music-festival story (see ## Relationships); the Frank Ocean tour he described to Dave on 2023-08-14 as having ended with the Tokyo show predates this remark, which suggests more recent performing with Frank Ocean (details in ## Frank Ocean collaboration; confirmed on 2023-10-19, when he told Dave he has started touring with Frank Ocean — see ## Frank Ocean collaboration) [S23T10].
- On 2023-10-23, on the balance and pressure of touring/fame (complementing his earlier motivation answers, see above): the tour is incredible and energizing, but fame has its own challenges — balancing it all has been tough; he takes it one day at a time, it can get overwhelming with so many demands, but he enjoys what he does so he pushes on; a strong support system is a key strategy — his friends and team keep him on track [S25T2][S25T4][S25T6].
- On 2023-10-23, when Dave asked (after Dave shared his good conversation with neighbors about current events and politics) how he stays informed and inspired: staying connected and up-to-date on world events is important to him — it helps his music stand out by incorporating unique perspectives, connects him better with his fans, and keeps him motivated and inspired [S25T8].

Dave: That's a great approach, Cal! Reminding yourself of the passion for the goals and getting help from others is really important. Taking a break and having fun sounds so refreshing. Oh, I just got back from a music festival - it was amazing! The energy, the music, the crowd - sooo good. I felt so alive!
[S23T5] (dia_id: D23:5)

Calvin: Wow Dave, sounds awesome! Music festivals bring so much joy and the energy of the crowd can be amazing. Got any photos from the festival? I'd love to check them out and join in on the fun.
[S23T6] (dia_id: D23:6)

Dave: Yep! I got this awesome pic from the event. The main stage was unreal. The headliner was so good and the vibe was unreal!
[Image caption: a photo of a stage with a crowd of people watching a band]
[S23T7] (dia_id: D23:7)

Calvin: Wow, that looks awesome! The crowd looks really excited and the stage is incredible. Who was the headliner?
[S23T8] (dia_id: D23:8)

Dave: The Fireworks headlined the festival.
[S23T9] (dia_id: D23:9)

Calvin: Wow, I heard great things about The Fireworks! Performing with Frank Ocean recently has been really cool. Seeing them perform live must've been awesome - I bet the energy was electric! That's why I love my job so much - connecting with the crowd.
[S23T10] (dia_id: D23:10)

Dave: Yeah, Calvin! The crowd had such a buzz. Music brings people together in such an amazing way, and it's just like when I'm fixing up things. I love the feeling of taking something broken and making it whole again. That's why I keep doing what I do.
[S23T11] (dia_id: D23:11)

Calvin: Yeah, Dave! Music and repairing things are so fulfilling and satisfying. Seeing something go from broken to whole is incredible. You're making a difference too - it's amazing. Keep it up, friend.
[S23T12] (dia_id: D23:12)

Dave: Thanks, buddy. Your support really helps. It's great to have a friend who believes in me. I'll keep pushing.
[S23T13] (dia_id: D23:13)

Calvin: I believe in you, Dave. Keep pushing and never forget how awesome you are.
[S23T14] (dia_id: D23:14)

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- As of 2023-08-22, scored a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean — "a dream come true"; "I've been working hard and it's finally paying off", and "no words can describe how happy I am" [S15T2].
- How it came about: he met Frank Ocean at a music festival in Tokyo and they clicked; they've been speaking and sharing ideas, arranged a meeting, and Calvin recorded a song in the studio at his mansion (the mansion he is turning into a recording studio, see ## Recording studio (2023-07-21)) — "it's been great!" [S15T4]. (This may be the Tokyo music festival he attended on 2023-04-20 — see ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20) — but that is not confirmed.)
- On that festival: the city was "buzzing with energy" and the festival crowd was "so lively" — "it was like fuel for my soul"; he called the experience "a dream come true" — "The festival had buzzing energy and a super upbeat crowd. We all felt connected, it was amazing!"; shared a photo of the crowd (people sitting on the grass at night) [S15T6][S15T8].

Calvin: Hey Dave! Long time no see. I just went to an awesome music thingy in Tokyo - so cool!
[S3T1] (dia_id: D3:1)

Dave: Hey Calvin! Great to hear from you. How was the music thingy in Tokyo? See any cool bands?
[S3T2] (dia_id: D3:2)

Calvin: Hey Dave! The festival in Tokyo was awesome! Didn't see any bands, but met lots of talented artists and industry people. Totally enriching!
[S3T3] (dia_id: D3:3)

Dave: Wow, Calvin, sounds great! What did you learn from it?
[S3T4] (dia_id: D3:4)

Calvin: I learned a lot and got some great advice from professionals in the music industry. It was inspiring!
[S3T5] (dia_id: D3:5)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! Bet that was inspiring being surrounded by professionals. Did you get any advice from them?
[S3T6] (dia_id: D3:6)

Calvin: The producer gave me some advice to stay true to myself and sound unique. It got me thinking about where I want my music to go. It's really motivating!
[S3T7] (dia_id: D3:7)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! It's really motivating to see you staying true to yourself. It got me thinking, where do you see your music taking you?
[S3T8] (dia_id: D3:8)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'm dreaming of touring the world, performing for different people and connecting with them. I hope my music can reach a global audience and make an impact. I'm also looking forward to my upcoming trip to Boston after I finish the Frank Ocean tour. I've heard that the music scene there is awesome, so I can't wait to check it out!
[S3T9] (dia_id: D3:9)

Dave: Sounds like an amazing plan, Cal! I can't wait for your trip to Boston. I'll show you around town and all the cool spots. The music scene there is awesome, with places like Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park. You'll definitely have some great performances there. Count me in for the front row when you're up onstage! Oh, and by the way, check out this pic.
[Image caption: a photography of a city skyline with a boat in the water]
[S3T10] (dia_id: D3:10)

Calvin: Wow, Boston looks great! Thanks for the tips. And, awesome pic!
[S3T11] (dia_id: D3:11)

Dave: Last weekend I went to a car show. Classic cars are so charming and the dedication people put into restoring them is amazing. That's why I'm so into auto engineering. Can't wait to show you some when you come to Boston! Oh, almost forgot to send a photo, look at this beautiful car!
[Image caption: a photography of a green mustang parked in a field of grass]
[S3T12] (dia_id: D3:12)

Calvin: Wow, Dave, that car looks great! Take a look at my car, I put a lot of work into it. Can't wait to see more when I'm in Boston!
[Image caption: a photo of a red sports car on display at a show]
[S3T13] (dia_id: D3:13)

Dave: Thanks! It definitely took a lot of work. Have you had a chance to check out Boston apart from the gigs?
[S3T14] (dia_id: D3:14)

- The 2023-08-14 conversation continued: Dave told Calvin the car restoration is "going great" and shared a photo of it (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)); Calvin predicted it "is going to look amazing when you're done" and asked how long it would take. Dave said Calvin's support "means a lot to [him]" [S14T11][S14T12][S14T13][S14T15].
- The 2023-08-14 conversation closed with Calvin cheering Dave on — "You got this, Dave! I'm always here for you. Seeing your enthusiasm is amazing. Keep growing, buddy. It'll be worth it! Good luck with that. See ya!" — after Calvin said Dave "has some serious talent" and he was "really excited to see the end result of [Dave's] hard work" [S14T14][S14T16].
- On 2023-08-22, reconnected with Calvin ("Haven't talked in a while!"): Dave shared that he'd had a card night with friends on 2023-08-18 (details in ## Card night (2023-08-18)); Calvin told him he scored a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean — "a dream come true" — and Dave: "Wow Calvin, congrats! Super excited for you." and asked how the chance came up; Calvin explained that he met Frank at a music festival in Tokyo, they clicked, and they recorded a song in Calvin's mansion studio; Dave: "Wow, Tokyo sounds like an incredible experience!" and asked what it was like playing at the festival; Calvin described the buzzing energy, the lively crowd, and "We all felt connected, it was amazing!", sharing a photo of the crowd sitting on the grass at night (Calvin's side in the Frank Ocean collaboration section of /memories/calvin.md) [S15T1][S15T2][S15T3][S15T4][S15T5][S15T6][S15T7][S15T8].
- The 2023-08-22 conversation continued: Dave asked if any other collaborations came out of that performance and about any upcoming concerts; Calvin said someone noticed his performance and now they're working together — "which is wild" — and that his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston, proposing they meet up (details in the Boston trip section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "Sounds great! Fill me in on the details when you have them and let's meet up when you're here. Can't wait to hear all about everything!" Calvin added that on 2023-08-21 ("yesterday" as of 2023-08-22) he and his friends recorded a podcast where they discuss the rapidly evolving rap industry; Dave: "That sounds fantastic! I'm looking forward to listening to your podcast and learning more about the rap industry. Keep up the great work!"; Calvin said he'd let Dave know when the podcast will be uploaded, "Take care!"; Dave: "Sure, Calvin! Looking forward to hearing about it. See ya then!" [S15T9][S15T10][S15T11][S15T12][S15T13][S15T14][S15T15].
- On 2023-08-31, reconnected with Calvin ("Long time no chat!"): Dave asked how the end of the tour was ("I bet it was amazing!"), and Calvin said the tour was amazing — "so pumped from all the energy from the audience" — sharing a photo of a crowd watching a concert with a large screen; Dave: "Wow, that looks amazing!" and asked how it was performing on that big stage; Calvin: "a dream come true", "on top of the world", "seriously surreal"; Dave: "Wow, that must have been an incredible experience! Congrats on achieving such an awesome moment!"; Calvin said he'd started shooting a video for his new album the weekend before (~2023-08-25/26), sharing a photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach; Dave: "Can't wait to see it", and asked "Will it be shot on location?"; Calvin: the shoot is in Miami, on an awesome beach — "It's going to have some epic visuals!"; the conversation continued with Dave saying the Miami beaches are awesome and that he can't wait to see them, and Calvin saying he loves the Miami vibe, it's "perfect for the vid", and "can't wait to show you!"; Dave was excited to see the vibe and location and offered to help with props or anything else for the video ("I'm here to support you!" / "let me know when, I'm here to lend a hand. It's great to fuel your ideas."); Calvin thanked him, said he'll let Dave know if he needs any assistance with props or anything else, and "Your support is much appreciated." The chat then turned to the photo Dave had sent once of Calvin's custom guitar with an octopus on it — Dave: "Love how this guitar shows our different artistic styles." — and Calvin explained he had it custom made by his Japanese artist friend, that the octopus represents his love for art and the sea, and that it's one of his favorites; Dave: "That's a great guitar, Calvin! Love the design, it's so unique and special.", and Calvin: "Cheers, mate! Really appreciate it. This guitar means so much to me; it's a reminder of my passion for music and the amazing friendships I've made."; Dave: "Wow, Calvin, this instrument obviously means a lot to you - it's like a representation of your journey, your passion for music, and the friendships you've made. Amazing!"; Calvin: "It's like every mark and strum holds a story", sharing a photo of the guitar with a purple glow; Dave marveled at the "gorgeous purple hue" and asked why it is so shiny, and Calvin said he had it customized with a shiny finish because it gives it a unique look and goes with his style; Dave: "Good pick!" and "Looks great on you! Your unique style really stands out in your music and playing."; Calvin: "Thanks, dude! I dig how it's so unique. It's totally my style!", and said that staying true to himself and being unique in his music is something he values, so it's great that Dave appreciates it; Dave then affirmed — "Definitely, staying true to yourself and your style is vital. It makes you unique and your music stand out. Keep it real, bud. You've got something great to give the world." — and re-shared, in that message, a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage (matches the photo of his shop work he shared on 2023-05-03 — see ## Car maintenance shop) (Calvin's side in the Music video and Octopus guitar sections of /memories/calvin.md) [S16T1][S16T2][S16T3][S16T4][S16T5][S16T6][S16T7][S16T8][S16T9][S16T10][S16T11][S16T12][S16T13][S16T14][S16T15][S16T16][S16T17][S16T18][S16T19][S16T20][S16T21][S16T22][S16T23][S16T24][S16T25].

Calvin: Hey Dave! Been ages since we chatted. So much has gone down. Touring with Frank Ocean last week was wild. Tokyo was unreal -- the crowd was insane. I felt so alive when performing, can't find the words to express it.
[S7T1] (dia_id: D7:1)

Dave: Wow, that's awesome, Cal! I bet it was an incredible experience. Congrats! Look what I've been up to recently, that's my neighbor's car. He's been having some trouble with the engine, but now it's done by myself!
[Image caption: a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage]
[S7T2] (dia_id: D7:2)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! It was an amazing experience - the energy and love from the fans was crazy. The car in the pic? It's the one you were fixing up the engine for a friend? Working on cars helps me chill and clear my head.
[S7T3] (dia_id: D7:3)

Dave: Yes, Cal! It's not difficult for me to help my neighbors with their cars. Working on cars is definitely therapeutic. Does it relax you as much as it does me?
[S7T4] (dia_id: D7:4)

Calvin: Yeah, totally! Fixing cars really calms me down and gives me a real sense of achievement - like meditating. Do you have any hobbies that give you the same satisfaction?
[S7T5] (dia_id: D7:5)

Dave: I'm passionate about fixing up things. It's more than just a hobby - it gives me a sense of achievement and purpose. I get a real buzz transforming something that's not working into something that runs smoothly - it's like giving it a second chance.
[S7T6] (dia_id: D7:6)

- On 2023-05-16, still in Tokyo: shared a photo of the Tokyo night skyline taken "last night" (2023-05-15) — "the skyline was stunning"; Dave praised the shot and said he has to take a trip to Tokyo soon [S6T13][S6T14][S6T15][S6T16]. Calvin thanked Dave and said the city lights in Tokyo are amazing, encouraging Dave to visit — "it's awesome!" [S6T17].
- As of 2023-05-16, he has an upcoming performance in Tokyo "this month" (May 2023) he is "super excited" for — great to show his music to a whole new crowd and hopefully expand his following [S6T11].
- As of 2023-05-31, he had been touring with Frank Ocean the week before (~2023-05-22/28) and called it "wild"; the Tokyo show was "unreal" — the crowd was "insane" — and performing "felt so alive" he "can't find the words to express it"; the energy and love from the fans was "crazy" [S7T1][S7T3]. This was the Frank Ocean tour his planned Boston trip was to follow (see the Boston trip section below); as of 2023-05-31, Boston is a stop on this tour itself.
- On 2023-08-14, updated Dave that the tour with the well-known artist (the Frank Ocean tour, see above) ended with a show in Japan — the Tokyo show was "awesome": everyone was "so into it" when he played one of his songs and sang along, which he called "a magical moment"; feeling of performing and connecting with the audience "was unreal"; after the tour he had the opportunity to explore his new place (the Japanese mansion, see ## New home (2023-03-23)) — "it's like a dream come true!" [S14T4][S14T6].
- On 2023-08-31, when Dave asked how the end of the tour was, Calvin said the tour was amazing — he was "so pumped from all the energy from the audience" — and shared a photo of a crowd watching a concert with a large screen ("This pic totally captures how I felt. Such an amazing time!"); when Dave asked how it was performing on that big stage, Calvin said it was "a dream come true" — the energy was incredible, he "felt on top of the world", and it was "seriously surreal" [S16T2][S16T3][S16T4].
- On 2023-10-19, told Dave he has started touring with Frank Ocean ("lots happened" since they last talked) — "it's been amazing": so much energy from the crowd and "such a connection when I'm on stage — unreal!"; the tour "has been great" and "jamming with Frank Ocean is a dream come true" (another Frank Ocean tour after the earlier ones listed here — Dave is looking forward to attending one of its shows, see the 2023-10-19 entry in ## Relationships) [S24T1][S24T3].
- On 2023-10-19, shared another photo of the tour crowd: a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air — "Wow, the crowd energy is amazing! It always gets me so pumped and it's awesome. Look at that photo, that was awesome!"; when Dave asked where it was taken, Calvin said it was taken in Tokyo during a concert — "the energy was nuts - felt like the whole city came out!" (Dave's enthusiasm about visiting Tokyo, see /memories/dave.md > ## Japan) [S24T9][S24T10][S24T11].
- On 2023-10-19, announced he's actually going to Tokyo in November 2023 ("next month") after the tour ends — shared a photo of a city at night with a tall building in the background ("What a great view!") and said "Sometimes I wish I could go back to places like [that]"; spots he's excited to check out: Shibuya Crossing — "like Tokyo's Times Square" — and Shinjuku; he can't wait to try the amazing food there again (shared a photo of Shibuya Crossing at night — a crowd of people with umbrellas in the rain); he has never tried ramen but "it's supposed to be awesome" — "Gonna give it a shot while in Tokyo!" — after Dave (who tried ramen in Boston) encouraged him (Dave's side in /memories/dave.md > ## Japan) [S24T17][S24T19][S24T21].

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Excited to drive again. Appreciate your help! Look what a wonderful view from living room!
[Image caption: a photo of a view of a small town with a mountain in the background]
[S9T11] (dia_id: D9:11)

Dave: Wow, what an amazing view! Where is it? I haven't seen anything like that before!
[S9T12] (dia_id: D9:12)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! It's from a small town in Japan. The view of the mountains is unbelievably stunning!
[S9T13] (dia_id: D9:13)

Dave: Wow! Did you get to that place yet?
[S9T14] (dia_id: D9:14)

Calvin: Nope, not yet! I haven't been there before, but it's on my to-do list for after my tour with Frank Ocean ends. Can't wait to see them in person! Look at that snowy peak.
[Image caption: a photo of a person on skis on a snowy mountain]
[S9T15] (dia_id: D9:15)

Dave: Looks awesome! Have you ever tried skiing before? It looks like loads of fun!
[S9T16] (dia_id: D9:16)

Calvin: Haven't tried it before, but it does look like a lot of fun! I might give it a try once. So what's up with you, is anything new in your daily routine?
[S9T17] (dia_id: D9:17)

Dave: Yes, Cal! I recently joined a rock band and have been practicing guitar. Look at this photo – it's us, the guys! 
[Image caption: a photography of a group of men playing instruments in a room]
[S9T18] (dia_id: D9:18)

Calvin: Playing guitar in a rock band is awesome, Dave! It will bring you a lot of emotions.
[S9T19] (dia_id: D9:19)

Dave: Sounds good, Calvin! Good company and great music, lift the mood and bring a lot of positive emotions! I have to go now. I'll see you soon!
[S9T20] (dia_id: D9:20)

question.question: When did Calvin and Frank Ocean start collaborating?
When did Calvin and Frank Ocean start collaborating?
